summary: Replacement gear set for a goBILDA 2000 Series Torque servo. It is a loose kit of four compound spur gears (one with a pressed-in bearing), two steel shafts and two bronze bushings, not a single assembled part. The bounding box below is an estimate for the largest gear, the largest single component.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat face of the large gear, which seats against the servo case or an adjacent gear in the train

notes: No dimensions were scraped or stated. The estimate assumes the set fits a standard-size servo case of about 40 x 20 x 37 mm, as in the servo photos, so the largest gear is roughly 38-40 mm in diameter. The compound gear stack height is assumed to be about 16 mm. The 4 mm bore is assumed from the small shaft and bushing proportions. Tooth counts and module are not given and were not inferred. The hole is a single representative bore at the gear center. The other gears, shafts and bushings are not modeled individually, and no mounting pattern is visible.
